chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Feed (eat) on the day of Al-Fitr before you go out to the prayer place.

key_terms.الْمُصَلَّى: The prayer place (specifically for Eid prayers)
key_terms.يَوْمَ الْفِطْرِ: The day of Eid al-Fitr (1st Shawwal)

ai.seo_question: What is the recommended practice regarding eating before Eid al-Fitr prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi emphasizes the Sunnah of consuming an odd number of dates before departing for the Eid al-Fitr prayer, a practice rooted in the Prophet’s tradition to symbolize the conclusion of Ramadan. Shia scholars highlight this act as a tangible expression of gratitude for the completed fasts and a means of distinguishing the day of Eid from the preceding month of fasting.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al Halby, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Feed on the day of Al-Fitr before you go out to the Prayer place’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘ Umayr from Hammad from al-Halabiy who has said the following: “Abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that
you should take food, on the day of al-Fitr before going to the prayer place.”
